name: MVBench
intro: MVBench 是一个多模态视频理解基准，以“静态到动态”方法把 9 类空间任务扩展为 20 项时序任务，并从 11 个公开视频数据集构建 4,000 道多项选择题，专门检验无法由单帧可靠解决的动态理解能力。
org: Shenzhen Institute of Advanced Technology, Chinese Academy of Sciences, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences, Shanghai AI Laboratory, The University of Hong Kong, Fudan University, State Key Laboratory for Novel Software Technology, Nanjing University
build_method: 静态到动态任务设计, 公共视频标注转换, LLM辅助问题与选项处理
eval_feature: 时序敏感, 标准答案确定性评分
scale: 4,000道多项选择题；20项任务，每项200题
build_method_en: Static-to-dynamic task design, public-video annotation conversion, LLM-assisted question and option processing
intro_en: MVBench is a multimodal video-understanding benchmark that expands nine spatial task categories into 20 temporal tasks through a static-to-dynamic design and constructs 4,000 multiple-choice questions from 11 public video datasets to test dynamic understanding that a single frame cannot reliably solve.

drawio_review_note: Evidence pinned to arXiv:2311.17005v4, Ask-Anything commit 4dd8210b030374bb0c510a57dfbe916f70d3ef71, evaluator commits eb6a79a080abbaa4e1c75cf5da135067a9da4c00 and 71ac7a28183a3d9610ad149f19ee2195cc31c65e, and Hugging Face snapshot 230a2d4fac8900333c61754641c7a13e069ac9c6. The diagram preserves the paper's nine spatial categories to 20 temporal tasks, 11 source datasets, diversity and mainly 5-35-second temporal filtering, STAR boundary shifts, CLEVRER condition cap, direct-QA versus ChatGPT question generation, template versus LLM option construction, separate 3-5 option sampling, shuffling and LLM length balancing, and 200 questions per task for 4,000 total. The pinned snapshot has 3,569 unique [question, answer, candidates] signatures among 4,000 rows, with 151 repeated-signature groups spanning 582 rows. It also contains five one-option and 118 two-option rows despite the paper's 3-5-option description. Evaluation follows the official notebook's bounded-video versus full-video/frame branch, VideoChat2's model-specific 16-frame reference preprocessing, temporal prompt, deterministic decoding, first-line retention, and lowercased first-token containment check after stripping periods from the predicted option token; answer content is ignored, with row-level per-task and overall accuracy and no LLM judge. Sixteen frames is not asserted as a universal benchmark rule. The benchmark is only partly public because rights remain source-dependent and 320 NTU videos require separate access. Formal publication evidence [site-a11q-paper-alignment]: normalized Draw.io and architecture sidecars plus native fixed-light SVG/PNG pairs were regenerated from the checked-in bilingual specs. Final PNG dimensions are 3765×1049 (English) and 3741×1049 (Chinese); SVG viewBoxes are 3763×1047 and 3739×1047. The final exports were inspected without clipping, node overlap, connector-node crossing, fallback text, or adaptive colors.
